nodes.characterization_summary: β-Ni(OH)₂ exhibits brucite-type structure with lattice parameters a = b = 0.31 nm, c = 0.46 nm, and γ = 120°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: For the brucite-type structure of β-Ni(OH)₂, the angle between a- and b-axes, namely γ, is 120°, and the values of a, b and c are 0.31, 0.31 and 0.46 nm, respectively (Fig. 1(b)).

nodes.characterization_summary: α-Ni(OH)₂ has the same ab-plane layered structure with β-Ni(OH)₂, but interlayer distance ranges from 0.41 to 0.80 nm due to intercalated anions and water molecules.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The α-Ni(OH)₂ has the same ab-plane layered structure with β-Ni(OH)₂, however, it always consists of abundant positive charged Ni(OH)₂₋ₓ layers. To restore charge neutrality, its interlayer space is always intercalated with anions and water molecules, broadening its interlayer distance ranges from 0.41 to 0.80 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: STM images (60 nm × 60 nm) show Ni(OH)₂ clusters with height of 0.7 nm and width of 8-10 nm on Pt(111) electrode.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Markovic's group found that the HER activity of Pt(111) electrode modified with Ni(OH)₂ clusters with height of 0.7 nm and width of 8-10 nm was about 7 times higher... STM images 60 nm × 60 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show both multi-layer Ni(OH)₂ and single-layer Ni(OH)₂ evenly adsorbed on the surface of Pt/C nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: both ML Ni(OH)₂ and ML Ni(OH)₂ can be evenly adsorbed on the surface of Pt/C nanoparticles as shown in Fig. 3(a) and (b).

nodes.characterization_summary: α-Co(OH)₂ has larger interlayer distance (0.70 nm) than β-Co(OH)₂ (0.46 nm) because of the interlayer intercalated anions and water molecules.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The layered Co(OH)₂ also have two polymorphs of α- and β-Co(OH)₂... the α-Co(OH)₂ has a larger interlayer distance (0.70 nm) than that of β-Co(OH)₂ (0.46 nm) because of the interlayer intercalated anions and water molecules.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images of Pt@2D-Ni(OH)₂ with different Pt loadings (19%, 64%, 83 wt%) show Pt nanocrystals coverage on Ni(OH)₂ nanosheets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images of Pt@2D-Ni(OH)₂ with 19 (a), 64 (b) and 83 wt% (c) of Pt; ... the area coverage was estimated by counting the number of Pt nanoparticles and measuring the particle sizes.
